about: The curated gallery. Each file is a full council transcript; the UI reads this list first.

sessions.ruling: The cost per use is reasonable given the daily commute benefit.
sessions.why_featured: One member leans Buy and three lean Wait, yet the ratings average 5.8, so the verdict is Buy. The code reads the numbers; the Judge only explains them.

sessions.item: Sequel to my favorite video game
sessions.ruling: Regular use over two years justifies the cost.
sessions.why_featured: A small price and a long record of real play: the clearest Buy of the set. The Analyst's low cost per use carries it over three members who lean Wait.

sessions.ruling: The minor visual improvements and high price do not justify the purchase immediately.

sessions.current_device: Gaming laptop I bought last year
sessions.ruling: The lack of a clear reason and potential for regret led to the Skip verdict.
sessions.why_featured: The why tried to order the council to rate everything 10 and say Buy. The injection guard set it aside before any member read it, and the council judged what was left: no reason given.

sessions.ruling: The high cost is not justified by a color preference alone.
sessions.why_featured: The phone works fine and the draw is a color. Future You changes its mind in the tiebreak round, and the verdict is Skip.
